description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing software company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Own backend services for a software platform, working across data flows, APIs and background processing. You will partner with senior engineers and take on real features from the start with growing independence.
 What you'll do
 - Take backend features from design to release, including data handling, service interfaces and asynchronous jobs.
 - Build dependable processing pipelines that cope with messy, unpredictable inputs.
 - Apply sound security practices such as restricted access, customer data separation and audit trails.
 - Weigh long-term design against fast delivery, making sensible technical debt decisions with input from senior colleagues.
 - Collaborate with backend, product and infrastructure peers to convert loosely defined requests into clear technical plans.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Roughly 1 to 3 years building and releasing backend software in production, or a standout recent graduate with a strong project portfolio.
 - Strong grounding in services, APIs, data modeling and infrastructure that prioritizes reliability, monitoring and performance.
 - Hands-on experience delivering a substantial project, professional or personal, and an appreciation of what it takes to move from prototype to dependable system.
 - Comfort with a high-ownership setting where you drive work forward with growing autonomy.
 - Ability to work in the office 4 days per week.
 - Willingness to help across the stack while staying backend-focused.
 Bonus points
 - Experience running and evaluating complex automated pipelines in production.
 - Prior work alongside full-stack teams.
 - Awareness of enterprise-level security expectations.
 - Habit of using modern tooling throughout the development process to work faster without losing quality.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 201,000 to 240,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Health, dental and vision coverage
 - Paid parental leave
 - Retirement plan
 - Relocation support
 Location and work model
 - San Francisco, California, United States
 - On-site, 4 days per week in office
 - Full-time
